sentences.en: And I testify that this is the Son of God.
sentences.zh: 我作证说这是上帝的儿子。

sentences.en: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light.
sentences.zh: 他来作为那光的见证人，证明这光的存在。

sentences.en: He testified that no money changed hands at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 他在会上声明没有钱交易过手。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：testi（证据）+fy（使…）→用证据证明→作证
